text.text_excerpt: Looks like live music / shows are slowly starting to come back. Went to Carnaval for the first time (despite recently moving nearby) for a showcase for the Strange Daisy Label! Full disclosure; I don't think I experienced everything the space probably had to offer. But I'll start with the good; really fast service from the bar despite a hectic crowd! Great stage / lighting / atmosphere for the show! Water and cups were freely available for patrons, which is always good practice. Good kitchen in the back: the crawfish "eggrolls" were super weird but yummy, and the dipping sauce they come with is delicious. My partner got the burger, and only complained that it fell apart too quickly. My on...
Very nice (relatively new) venue, easily reached on St Claude. We saw a favored band and enjoyed the atmosphere, fine beverages, good sound, right amount of light. Worth checking out.

Walked in go be greeted by worker was not letting you in without our vaccination passport (love this)! No vaccination-stay home!!!! Last night I went to see old friends Leroy Jones & Katja. Brought back memories of Donna's (now that was some good times)! Leroy is better than ever in his career! His rendition on Sentimental Mood almost brought me to tears (just beautiful), and Carnivals in town is of course another favorite! Music on point, Exactly what I expected and more. Sound quality could have been a little louder for the bass (what do I know). I venue is on St. Claude the cities newest take over (smiling). Not a fan of the aera but no problems.
